title: Harmonious Light Tunisian Chilli Tagine
description: A comforting and herbal Tunisian dish featuring green chilli, this tagine is light and raw-friendly, made with a whisk and served hot.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large clay or ceramic tagine or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the diced green chilli and cook for 2 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 20 minutes, or until the flavors have melded together and the chilli is tender.
Use a whisk to stir the tagine and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
